people.name: Karusa
people.who: A freed Shadar-Kai who walks with the company.
people.says: "You were there when the iron came off. I'll keep up."
people.wants: To be treated as a person, not a rescue. Plain dealing, and no pity.

rewards.Known: She keeps a watch for you. While she's on watch, you can't be surprised.
rewards.Trusted: Once per long rest, before a fight starts, she names one creature there that means you harm. Your first attack against it has advantage.
rewards.Sworn: Once per long rest, when a hit lands on you, she steps in and takes it instead.

chronicle.text: One of the three who freed her from the Sallow Compound.
Bought her off the Sallow Compound showroom for 350 gp and struck the collar off in a back lane, asking nothing in return.
Helped outfit her at Jorik's Forge.
Bought her first real kit at Jorik's Forge.
She trusted him with something of her past that she has shown no one else.
At the Grey Pot she told him a little of her past, and said she'd like to see his home some day.
They met at Pergame's gates. She had never met him before.

people.name: Vassek Holloweye
people.who: The coin-keeper of Caldwharf. Most of the port owes him.
people.says: "You saw a man buying people quietly and chose to stand with him. From that, I let you in."
people.wants: People bought off the chain and kept off it, quietly, with nobody looking his way.

rewards.Known: He changes, holds and lends coin at a fair rate, and keeps your money safe in the Counting-House.
rewards.Trusted: Once per visit, a clean set of papers and a new name for one person, good in any port of the Sunkland.
rewards.Sworn: You're written into his book. Any freed person in Caldwharf will hide you, feed you and lie for you.

chronicle.text: Read what Vassek really does, shelters slaves off the chain, and stood with him instead of blowing it open before the Keeper's town; he made the trio allies.

His Oath of Vengeance flared at the collared folk of the Ember; he held, read what Vassek truly does, shelters slaves off the chain, and stood with him. The work aligns with his oath; Vassek made him an ally.

people.name: Kira Vost
people.who: House Varn's training master.
people.says: "You swing like the swing is the whole plan. But you made me work. Most don't. Come to the Garrison."
people.wants: Students who earn the lesson. She has no time for charm in place of skill.

rewards.Known: She named your flaw. Once per long rest, when you miss with a melee attack, you can reroll it.
rewards.Trusted: Garrison drill. Once per long rest, at the start of a fight, you choose your place in the initiative order.
rewards.Sworn: Her company fights beside you once: a squad of Varn veterans for one battle.

chronicle.text: Sparred the Varn training master at the Kennels yard, lost a good, hard bout; she named his flaw and opened a door to the Garrison.

people.name: Velvet Thorn
people.who: Keeper of the Velvet Thorn, and a broker of what she hears.
people.wants: Honest curiosity, a good dry conversation, and guests who don't perform.

rewards.Known: A room when the city is full, and the quiet table at the back.
rewards.Trusted: One question each visit about anyone in Crownfall: where they lodge, and who they've been seen with. She answers from what she's heard.
rewards.Sworn: While you're under her roof, nobody finds you without her say, the Watch included.

chronicle.text: A returning face at the bar she has decided she likes.
Comped a room for the good Ashford questions.
Sleeps in the corner of the bar; Velvet reads him as watchful.
Returned road-worn; keys set out without a word.

people.name: Broma
people.where: Broma's Forge, the Forge Ward, Crownfall
people.who: A master smith who works passion-fire, once of the Bastion's heart-forge.
people.wants: Honest work, paid for, and nobody asking about the Bastion.

rewards.Known: Lifetime upkeep on anything she made you, done overnight and free.
rewards.Trusted: She sells you the Custodian Shield off her shelf, at cost. Nobody's coming back for it.
rewards.Sworn: She tempers one weapon of yours in passion-fire. It deals an extra 1d6 fire damage, and its fire ignores resistance.

chronicle.text: Won the hand-forged war-maul at 20 gp on a nat-20; Broma added free lifetime maintenance.
Long-standing maintenance client of Broma's ('the metal man').

people.name: House Selvik
people.where: the Threshold House, the Kennels, Crownfall
people.who: The Veilwalkers: one of Crownfall's founding houses, who guide, map and recover in the Unclaimed.
people.says: "Contract crew. Reliable muscle on the Wall."
people.wants: Contracts closed clean, and the House's name kept clean.

rewards.Known: Posting rights on the Roll, and Selvik's outfitting at the usual rates.
rewards.Trusted: A Selvik map of any one route in the Unclaimed, or a Strider to guide you on it, free, once per contract.
rewards.Sworn: A Strider escort for one expedition, and the House's name as a letter of passage at every Selvik waystation.

chronicle.text: Closed two Roll contracts in three days (Bonefield, Brackish Pool).
Closed two Roll contracts in three days.
Closed the lost-caravan Orange clean, found the cause, recovered the manifest, no survivors to fault them for.
Their quarter for the dragon, 3,000 gp, was paid at the Selvik operation once Augustin Drey confirmed them.

people.name: House Vander
people.who: A minor Crownfall house. Lord Theron heads it; his son Tarrin reads its old papers.
people.wants: The family's lost western branch put to rest properly, and the Vander name kept respectable.

rewards.Known: Tarrin's copy of the lineage leaf that names Halric and Mara.
rewards.Trusted: The Vander library and Tarrin's time: he researches one question in old house and family papers for you.
rewards.Sworn: A letter under Lord Theron's seal that vouches for you to any house in Crownfall.

chronicle.text: Among the crew that brought the Twin Reach discovery.
Delivered the Twin Reach discovery personally; Theron entrusted his son to the crew.
Completed the Twin Reach contract, opened the vault, faced Halric, and brought two of the family's dead home: Halric and the never-born child.

people.name: Maren Thane
people.who: Head of House Thane and keeper of the Threshold's rites.
people.says: "You carried the small one to me and paid the work its due. The Threshold remembers a debt kept."
people.wants: The dead treated with respect, and honesty about how a death came.

rewards.Known: Your dead are taken in and given the rites, with no questions about how they died.
rewards.Trusted: Once per visit she sits a vigil with you, and one of the Threshold's dead answers one question.
rewards.Sworn: She keeps a body for you: one dead companion, kept whole in the Threshold's cold until you can bring them back.

chronicle.text: Helped bring Ratsby's body to the Threshold; paid the offering and gave the account; witnessed the rite.
Recalled the Mother-of-rites and led the party to her with Ratsby's body; paid the offering and gave the account.

people.name: Inquisitor Marek
people.who: A war-priest of the Church of the Vein. Not clever, and immensely strong.
people.says: "Then we're the same, you and me."
people.wants: Somebody strong enough to arm-wrestle, and a drink after.

rewards.Known: He vouches for you at Veinspire's gate and its rest-houses.
rewards.Trusted: He gets you another strength-worm from the Devotion Quarter, at his price: 20 gp.
rewards.Sworn: He warns you, once, before the Inquisition comes for you.

chronicle.text: Beat Farkas at arm-wrestling in a Veinspire rest-house (a real contest), adopted him as a friend for life, and let him in on the guard's strength-worm.

people.name: Thessaly
people.who: A bookseller of two thousand years, and the best private source on the world before the Usurpation.
people.wants: Old things kept, and the truth about them.

rewards.Known: At a glance, she tells you whether a book or relic is older than the Usurpation.
rewards.Trusted: One reading: she studies a book or text you bring her and tells you what it is and who made it.
rewards.Sworn: A book from her back room, her choice, given free.

chronicle.text: Came to the Frayed Codex with Viktor. She gave Viktor the black book she had never been able to read.

people.name: Azalea Hemm
people.who: The healer of the Pallid Crossroads, nineteen, who has run the clinic alone for five years.
people.wants: Patients who tell her the truth about what's wrong with them.

rewards.Known: She treats your wounds and sicknesses at cost.
rewards.Trusted: Once per visit she lifts one curse, disease or poison from one of you, free.
rewards.Sworn: A kit of her own making. When you stabilise a creature with it, it also regains hit points equal to your level.

chronicle.text: Brought Karusa to the clinic and left when Azalea asked for privacy.
Visited the clinic with Viktor, then returned after dark for Azalea to preserve the paw.

people.name: Oo'ro'vae
people.who: Eldest of the Underkeel and its salvage-master.
people.says: "The three off the Span. Buyers, trouble, or chain-bait. I haven't decided which yet."
people.wants: People who pull their weight unasked, and take no more than the coast can give.

rewards.Known: His standing offer: he buys any Span salvage you bring him, at a fair price.
rewards.Trusted: He opens his log: which wrecks on the coast are live, and how to reach them.
rewards.Sworn: A berth on any Underkeel boat, any time, to anywhere on the Sunkland coast.

chronicle.text: Fair first dealing at the Yard; clocked as 'the three off the Span' and given his standing salvage offer, no trouble.
Fair first dealing at the Yard; bought a fish, made no trouble, and was clocked as one of 'the three off the Span'.

people.name: The Hollowsong
people.who: The cast-down of the Sunkland, who sing their grief openly.
people.wants: Grief left as it is, and no Singer near their wrecks.

rewards.Known: Shelter in the Underkeel, and a place by the fire.
rewards.Trusted: They teach you the grief-song. You have advantage on saving throws against being charmed, and no magic can calm or change your grief.
rewards.Sworn: Kae'le'tha names you one of theirs. The Hollowsong will hide you and fight for you anywhere in the Sunkland.

chronicle.text: Returned to the Underkeel from the western floe and the Span dive; Vo'la'me welcomed them at the Hearthhold and asked no questions.
Returned to the Underkeel from the western floe; Vo'la'me welcomed the sun-blood and poured for him unasked.

people.name: Bjarnok the Weather-Eater
people.who: The bearfolk who hunts the giant beasts of the Outgrown.
people.wants: Kills big enough to feed him, and nobody taking his.

rewards.Known: The paw he gave you is proof. The Outgrown's people let you through.
rewards.Trusted: He tells you where the weather-beasts are moving, and which way to go round them.
rewards.Sworn: He hunts with you once: Bjarnok joins one fight against something Gargantuan.

chronicle.text: His rage-yells revealed the White Silence's position; he initially refused the paw because Bjarnok dealt nearly all the killing damage.
Stood in the fight and now carries the paw as token and proof.

people.name: Marrek Voss
people.where: his farm, half a day east of Crownfall
people.who: A shepherd on the Unclaimed's edge east of Crownfall.
people.says: "You ever need a place east, the byre's open."
people.wants: His flock alive, and no trouble brought to his gate.

rewards.Known: The byre's open: a safe night half a day east of Crownfall, any time.
rewards.Trusted: He keeps your horses, goods or a person safe at the farm for as long as you need.
rewards.Sworn: One of his three dogs goes with you: a working dog that never loses a trail.

chronicle.text: Cleared the Brackish Pool den.
Cleared the Brackish Pool den; confirmed the lineage terminated.

people.name: Warden Hesse
people.where: the last gate on the road to Calvaria
people.who: The construct that tolls everyone who comes to Calvaria by road.
people.wants: The toll paid. Never coin, and never the same price twice.

rewards.Known: The gate opens for you once the toll is paid.
rewards.Trusted: It knows you. Your toll is always something small.
rewards.Sworn: The gate opens without a toll, for you and anyone you vouch for.

falls.Against you: Barred. The gate doesn't open for you.

chronicle.text: Gave a secret of no significance as his toll.
Refused to give a secret, was put outside, and is barred from the gate.

people.name: Drey's Crew
people.who: Augustin Drey's crew, who took the job on the dragon at the north crag.
people.says: "Get him up, it is not yet his time."
people.wants: Jobs done properly, dead things kept down, and the Hall told the truth.

rewards.Known: They bring you in on work: a fair cut of any bounty you help them close.
rewards.Trusted: Once per contract you share with them, if one of you dies, Lazare brings them back, as he did for Veezara.
rewards.Sworn: They take a job for you: the whole crew fights beside you for one contract.

chronicle.text: Fought the dragon beside them at the north crag. When its last burst killed Veezara, Drey told Lazare to get him up, and Lazare brought him back.
Drey came himself to confirm them at the Selvik operation, and they were paid their quarter for the dragon.

people.name: The Grey Pot's Innkeeper
people.who: The keeper of the Grey Pot, three streets from the Shadow Quay.
people.wants: His house kept neutral, and nobody exposed in his common room.

rewards.Known: A room with the mirrors covered. Nobody asks your business under his roof.
rewards.Trusted: He tells you when someone has been asking after you at the Grey Pot.
rewards.Sworn: The Grey Pot's back door: a way out of the Blackfold by night that skips the Shadow Quay's desk.

chronicle.text: Gave the company rooms. In the morning he had fresh bread out and sent Viktor to the reading room in the Gray Market.
Gave him salt for his door, and a bucket in the morning after the face crew came through the window.

people.name: Gulm
people.who: The thing that sits on the bridge at the neck and asks for food.
people.wants: Food.

rewards.Known: Feed him and you cross.
rewards.Trusted: He remembers you. You cross without paying, and he holds the bridge behind you against whoever follows.
rewards.Sworn: Gulm leaves the bridge for you once, and fights beside you.

chronicle.text: Tried to walk past him and was flung back; then paid a ration and crossed.
Found him maimed by frost and fire under the bridge. He said the fire man attacked him for asking for food.

people.name: The Lampwright
people.who: The oil merchant who runs the Shadow Pits.
people.wants: Purses, and the house's fifth of every one.

rewards.Known: A place on the card any fight night, at the usual purse.
rewards.Trusted: Bigger purses, and seats for your friends in the front tier.
rewards.Sworn: A second lamp of your own. Hung behind you, it throws two shadows; once per long rest, a creature attacking you strikes the wrong one and has disadvantage.

chronicle.text: Fought the Twice-Lit for a 600 gp purse and won. Paid 480 gp after the house's fifth.

people.name: The Dealer
people.where: the Green Door, the Kennels, Crownfall
people.who: Crownfall's magic-item dealer, and a finder of things.
people.says: "What do you want, or what do you want me to find."
people.wants: A fair trade, honestly described.

rewards.Known: He buys and sells magic items at fair rates.
rewards.Trusted: He finds one item for you. Name it, and within a tenday he knows where it is, or that it can't be had.
rewards.Sworn: First refusal: anything rare that comes through the Green Door is offered to you before anyone else sees it.

chronicle.text: Bought four legends from him at 50 gp each.

people.name: The face trade
people.who: The people who sell faces in the Blackfold. Somebody paid them for Veezara's.
people.wants: The face they were paid for.

rewards.Known: A licensed face from the Row, at the Row's prices.
rewards.Trusted: A face made to measure, that holds against magic for a tenday.
rewards.Sworn: They take a contract for you: one face, taken.

falls.Against you: They know which inn you sleep in.
falls.Enemy: They'll take your face while you sleep, and your friends' faces too.

chronicle.text: Stopped outside the reading room: somebody had paid for his face. Give it up, or they'd take it while he slept.
The crew came through the window of Farkas's room that night. The man in the elf's face and the patched thing died; the docker escaped.

people.name: Tharra Long-Watch
people.who: The giant who keeps the first giants' dead at the Pitfall. She shares Farkas's blood.
people.wants: That the dead are never left alone.

rewards.Known: She reads the marks on any giant-made thing for you.
rewards.Trusted: She teaches you the deep old tongue she speaks to the dead in. Once per long rest you can ask a giant's bones one question, and they answer.
rewards.Sworn: The cloak King Hrothgar gave her when he sent her to the rim. While you wear it, every giant of the western kingdoms treats you as the king's own kin.

ask.text: Come back to the rim before you go home.

chronicle.text: She read the clan-marks on his maul as her own line's, and it glowed in her hand. He told her the whole history of his world, and she believed him. She asked him to come back to the rim before he goes home.
She offered him the rim, the meadow on the Middle, or her stone after dark for watching the stars.

people.name: Godwin
people.who: The eldest of Amphiale, the village on the Ring.
people.wants: Strangers doing no harm in his village, and word sent if anyone sees her on the road.

rewards.Known: A bed in the village. Nobody in Amphiale asks where you came from.
rewards.Trusted: The village's boats: one takes you anywhere along the Hand's coast.
rewards.Sworn: A boat of your own, crewed by Amphiale's young men, for as long as you're on this side of the portal.

chronicle.text: Appeared in the lane. He told them where they stood, that she had drunk at the well some days before, walking west toward the Middle, and asked them to send word if they saw her.
Met Anvil in the same lane. This was twice now.

people.name: King Edric
people.who: The king of Ithake. He hears every petition himself and repeats it back before he answers.
people.wants: Every petition heard in its turn, and his daughter safe.

rewards.Known: Your petitions are heard the day you bring them, not in the line.
rewards.Trusted: His steward's seal: a pass through any gate of Ithake and onto any of its ships.
rewards.Sworn: The guard of Ithake fights for you once.

chronicle.text: Joscelin moved them up the line. Edric heard their petition, told them no one communes with her, and judged the Usurpation her will.

people.name: Briallen
people.who: Of the Greenwarders, keeper of the Bloomhollow. Aldwyn's sister.
people.wants: The grove kept, and the Maker left to walk where she likes.

rewards.Known: Rest in the grove. Greenwarder healing, as after the Middle, for whatever you bring in.
rewards.Trusted: She looks for you through the water. Once per visit she scries one place or person for you.
rewards.Sworn: A seed of the grove. Plant it, and by the next dawn a pale tree stands there; while you rest under it, nothing hostile finds you.

chronicle.text: She tried to find the Maker and couldn't. When they came back from the Middle half dead, she gave them a place to rest and looked down the Middle through the stream's water.

people.name: Tostig
people.who: A giant of the duelling field whose boy fought Farkas.
people.wants: A good bout, and his boy grown strong.

rewards.Known: A place in the ring: any giant on the field will fight you for a purse.
rewards.Trusted: He teaches you the field's grip. You can grapple creatures up to two sizes larger than you, and you have advantage on checks to escape a giant's grapple.
rewards.Sworn: His boy, grown, comes to fight beside you once.

chronicle.text: Beat his boy one on one. Tostig sat down in the dirt to hear the maul's story, and sent Farkas west to Phlegre for the smith who reads the marks.

people.name: Kaedris
people.who: Lemnor's war-captain. Her levies call her "Mam".
people.wants: Her levies fed, fit, and never sent to someone else's war.

rewards.Known: You can drill with her levies and eat at the barracks.
rewards.Trusted: Her drill. While you hold your ground (you haven't moved this turn), you and allies within 10 feet of you can't be pushed or knocked prone.
rewards.Sworn: She sends her levies with you once: forty in bronze scale, for one battle.

chronicle.text: She told him what the south knows of the war on the chalk, took his name and Karusa's, beat him in the yard and gave him a potion of healing. She asked what brought them to Lemnor; nobody has told her.

people.name: Sicart
people.who: An old dwarf paladin of the levies, the Oath-Smith.
people.wants: Oaths kept, and broken ones owned.

rewards.Known: He'll hear a confession: tell him what you failed to do, and he witnesses it.
rewards.Trusted: The struck scale he gave Veezara. While you wear it, you can't be charmed into breaking your oath, and once per long rest you can reroll a failed saving throw.
rewards.Sworn: He strikes a second oath with you at the deep forge. Name what you swear; while you keep it, you have +1 to saving throws.

chronicle.text: He told him the way back to his oath, heard his confession at the deep forge, watched him strike the oath into bronze, and gave him the struck scale on a cord.

people.name: Peire
people.who: The deaf smith who keeps the deep forge under Lemnor.
people.wants: Good metal, and people who speak up.

rewards.Known: He raps any metal you bring him and tells you what it is and what it's worth.
rewards.Trusted: He works one weapon or suit of armour on the glowing slab. It comes out fire-forged, +1.
rewards.Sworn: He works orichalc into one item of yours. It becomes +2.

chronicle.text: Let him swear his oath at the forge, and heard the confession.
Rapped a plate and listened: his frame is plain iron, and the amber pieces in his chest are orichalc.

people.name: Gaucelm
people.where: the street of the weapon-smiths, Lemnor
people.who: The Lemnor smith who forged Mind-Me.
people.wants: Work paid in full, and Fabrissa kept out of trouble.

rewards.Known: His racks: fire-forged bronze arms, +1 and +2, at his prices.
rewards.Trusted: He sets one more stone or facet in a weapon of yours, as he set the facets in Mind-Me.
rewards.Sworn: A fire-forged weapon of your choice, +2, made for you and given free.

chronicle.text: Stepped into the square between him and Fabrissa; he told Veezara who Kaedris was and where to find her.
Brought him the Mnemon Hart's three facets, and he agreed to forge them into a longsword.
Collected Mind-Me and paid 800 gp in full.

people.name: Ursula
people.who: Acheront's midwife, who cuts the first marks on its newborns.
people.wants: Nothing cut that isn't true.

rewards.Known: She reads the marks on any Shadar-Kai for you.
rewards.Trusted: She cuts a true mark on you: a scar for one deed you have really done. While it shows, the people of Acheront treat you as written.
rewards.Sworn: When the truth is found, she cuts it: a mother's line or an island, for anyone whose marks were left bare.

chronicle.text: She cut Karusa's name into her wrist and left the places for mother and island bare, because she would not cut what wasn't true.

people.name: Demelza
people.who: A glass-polisher of the Glass Steps. You brought her son back.
people.wants: Kenwyn safe.

rewards.Known: A bed in her house on the Long Canal.
rewards.Trusted: A lens of her own polishing. Once per long rest, look through it to see a creature's true form.
rewards.Sworn: Her house is yours. She and Kenwyn will hide you on the Long Canal from anyone, the queen's guard included.

chronicle.text: She came to the inn for the strangers with nothing written on them. They went into the hallway in her wall and brought Kenwyn back.

people.name: Ambrose
people.who: A man of the queen's guard. You brought back his oldest scar.
people.says: "Bring me back what it took, if you find it."
people.wants: The queen's order kept.

rewards.Known: He vouches for you at any gate of the city.
rewards.Trusted: He stood for you before the queen, and he'll do it again: one audience with her, whenever you ask.
rewards.Sworn: Two of his guard go with you once, anywhere in the isles.

chronicle.text: He kept the chalk line in Demelza's parlour and asked them to bring back what the hallway took. When the frame closed, his scar was back. He went up to the queen to stand for them.

people.name: Queen Elspeth
people.who: The queen of Acheront.
people.wants: Acheront kept free.

rewards.Known: Welcome in the Queen's Hall, and Simeon reads anyone you bring before her.
rewards.Trusted: Anything that is hers to give, once. Given: the First Knife, to Karusa, in S64.
rewards.Sworn: A mark of the queen's own cutting. You're written as Acheront's, and its gates, boats and guard are open to you.

chronicle.text: She thanked them before the court for clearing the hallway and offered them anything that was hers to give. They asked for an item, and she gave Karusa the First Knife. Asked about Phlegre, she said it was the land of the giants, as everyone knows.

people.name: Hereward of the Long Knife
people.where: the Steading of the Long Knife, the high plains
people.who: A giant herdsman on the road to Phlegre, who took you in.
people.wants: The herd in before the storm, and the roc kept off it.
people.image: images/S64 The Giant with the Long Knife.webp

rewards.Known: A meal at the stone table and a dry place in the long hall. Ælfthryth serves you first.
rewards.Trusted: An aurochs from the herd: a mount the size of a house that carries all of you across the high plains.
rewards.Sworn: His long knife.

chronicle.text: Helped him and his sons get the aurochs in before the storm, and killed the roc beside him; for the first time in ten storms it took no cow. He fed them in his hall and pointed them west to Phlegre.
Shook him awake when a stair opened in his hall. He waited at the edge of the frost, and when they came back up he said, "You came back."

people.name: Eadwulf Ember-Hand
people.who: Forge-father of the Long-Watch line. He read his own mark on Farkas's maul.
people.says: "This is my work. But it is old. Older than me."
people.wants: Long-Watch work kept in the line's hands.

rewards.Known: He reads every mark on a giant-made weapon, and sells Long-Watch work.
rewards.Trusted: He cuts your name among the maul's marks. While you wield it, you have +1 to attack and damage rolls with it.
rewards.Sworn: A Long-Watch piece made for you, for your blood alone.

chronicle.text: He read the marks on the Skyfather's Reckoning and stopped at his own. Farkas told him only that it came from his mother. He told Farkas about Ceolric and sold him a Forgework Dragon Shield.

people.name: Ceolric Stone-Wake
people.who: King Hrothgar's first warleader. He wants a war and can't get one.
people.wants: A war. Failing that, a fight worth having.

rewards.Known: You can drill with the young giants in his hall.
rewards.Trusted: He teaches you to fight something bigger. Once per long rest, for one minute, you have advantage on attacks against creatures two or more sizes larger than you.
rewards.Sworn: He brings his warband to your fight, once.

chronicle.text: Told him he was half giant, and Ceolric laughed: "Maybe quarter giant." Farkas asked him a number of questions and thanked him.

people.name: The Council of Eight
people.who: The eight who rule Pergame and the heartland.
people.wants: The heartland's law kept.

rewards.Known: Pergame's markets and houses of healing are open to you.
rewards.Trusted: A council writ: free passage through the heartland and its villages.
rewards.Sworn: The council's mark: the protection of Pergame's law anywhere in the heartland.

falls.Against you: Banished from the heartland. If you're found in Pergame or its lands again, you answer as Malcius did.

chronicle.text: On Maren Thane's reading, the council set him a blood-price of 1,000 gp for standing by while Malcius killed Talaris, paid to Talaris's widow and children, and banished him from the heartland. He paid.
